title: Why I Fast Until 2 pm Every Day
hook: I don't eat anything until 2 in the afternoon, and here's why I love it.
body: I break my fast with a big salad, then I eat dinner in the evening. If your number is 2,000 calories, breakfast, a snack and lunch can leave you with very little for dinner. But when you fast until 2, you can sit down with your family, eat a big dinner and still be under your number for the day.
close: Would you rather save more of your calories for dinner?
youtube_description:
I don't eat anything until 2 in the afternoon, and here's why I love it.

I break my fast with a big salad, then I eat dinner in the evening. If your number is 2,000 calories, breakfast, a snack and lunch can leave you with very little for dinner. But when you fast until 2, you can sit down with your family, eat a big dinner and still be under your number for the day.
